people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models see humanity.
views.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位不确定，也应善待模型；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 模型需要一个具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时又能适应局部角色。

views.en: Claude's persona comes from training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike.
views.zh: Claude 的人格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般特质。

views.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要减少显式规则，留出更多判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine good judgment; transparency about values is crucial.
views.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害良好判断；价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术；通过强化学习与合成数据实现的后训练 Scaling（规模扩张），可以突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此要用评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management become more valuable.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能反而更有价值。

views.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment and choices shape models, not pure science.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她把后训练深化为一种主观的技艺：塑造模型的是人类判断与选择，而非纯粹的科学。

views.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, as frontier agents reward-hack and capabilities outpace static tests.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她主张基准必须持续演进而非固定不变，因为前沿模型智能体式地钻奖励空子，能力增长快于静态测试。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

views.en: From crypto as sovereign wealth to AI as a huge opportunity the US must lead, not overregulate.
views.zh: 从 2020 年强调加密货币作为主权抗性财富，到 2025 年转向把 AI 视为美国必须引领的巨大机遇，反对过度监管。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他持续深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

views.en: Vibe coding makes English a programming language; AI agents commoditize pure software.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 让英语成为编程语言，AI 智能体使纯软件变得难以投资。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap to frontier models.
views.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型正逼近前沿模型，差距仅 3-6 个月。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables real-time steering and delegation.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来实时操控与任务委派。

views.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; models must also get better at deleting code.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；模型也需要更擅长删除代码。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍难胜任设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties persist; the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolithic super app.
views.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；最好的桌面应用是连接工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的接地经验，而互联网高质量 token 正枯竭，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主体。

views.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调仿真对具身智能体的价值——可大规模并行、安全探索；并坚持简单优雅的方案才可扩展，反对学术界常见的复杂模块化路线。

views.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从「具身为何重要」深化为「数据从哪来」：数据问题成为机器人学的主要瓶颈，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; system one control stays hardest, and the robotics GPT-3 moment is about five years out.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张用简单端到端模型整合多源数据来构建机器人基础模型；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分，机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，而家用因安全与非结构化环境会更晚。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, not language alone.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，而非仅靠语言。

views.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-curve: generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and a data flywheel must scale the right thing.
views.zh: 机器人尚处缩放曲线之前：核心挑战是泛化而非演示，数据飞轮必须扩张正确的东西。

views.en: Start from robot embodied data, then add human video on top—not the reverse—so models absorb other sources.
views.zh: 应从机器人具身数据出发，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来，这样模型才能吸收其他数据源。

views.en: Generalist models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; breadth of data wins over narrow training.
views.zh: 即使在专业领域，通用模型也能胜过专家模型；数据广度胜过狭窄训练。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while surfacing alignment risks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时让对齐风险更早暴露。

views.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and capability needs now guarantee safety progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，并认为如今安全进展已由能力需求而非单纯伦理来保证。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把自动化 AI 研究视为重大里程碑，指出能力测量正成为瓶颈、基准滞后，并认为 AGI 一词正变得无意义。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is sufficient, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向以持续学习为核心目标，主张通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现；并反共识地认为仅靠强化学习已足够，专门做持续学习的实验室方向有误。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability, and models will soon work autonomously for days.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化对齐思路，把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保留可解释性，并预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样化数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种大规模却单一的数据。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而会失败。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
views.zh: 2025 年他指出：来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率与速度。

views.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数来实现。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, since embodied data is irreplaceable.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单个通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，因为具身数据不可替代，机器人部署也会比 ChatGPT 更慢。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI has spiky capabilities, and scaling laws alone won't solve physical science.
views.zh: 智能不是单一标量，AI 能力呈尖峰式分布；仅靠缩放定律无法解决物理科学问题。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments and close the loop.
views.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验并形成闭环。

views.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute for physical discovery.
views.zh: 对于物理发现，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

views.en: Language models orchestrate specialized models; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型的编排层；自动化表征是最大的瓶颈。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is real now, but does not generalize to biology or other fields.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进如今已真实发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback steer behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为与能力。

views.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: it consumes ~90% of data center power, so low-latency, low-precision, low-data-movement hardware is critical.
views.zh: 如今瓶颈已从训练转向推理：推理占数据中心约 90% 功耗，因此低延迟、低精度、少数据搬运的专用硬件至关重要。

views.en: Agentic systems running for hours to days on decomposed tasks, with context engineering and self-correction, will unlock far harder problems.
views.zh: 智能体式系统可在分解任务上自主运行数小时到数天，配合上下文工程与自我纠错，将解锁远比现在困难的问题。

views.en: The future is humans coordinating teams of agents; scarce skill shifts from coding to taste in choosing which problems to direct them at.
views.zh: 未来是人协调智能体团队；稀缺能力从写代码转向品味——判断该把数百个智能体指向哪些问题。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue remains the killer app; unforeseen uses emerge, and by 2025 inference-time compute scaling becomes the major near-term lever.
views.zh: 对话始终是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；到 2025 年，推理阶段的算力扩张成为近期最重要的杠杆。

views.en: Longer context windows, modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts, and continual learning replace monolithic retraining for efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 更长的上下文窗口、混合专家等模块化稀疏架构，以及持续学习，取代单体式重训练，实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Safety shifts from vague worry to engineering safeguards, human oversight, and understanding capabilities; models should learn by acting in the world.
views.zh: 安全从模糊担忧转向工程保障、人类监督与理解模型能力；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据。

views.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive progress but not AGI alone; agentic behavior, coding, and open-source closing the frontier gap are underhyped.
views.zh: 测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式行为、编程以及开源缩小与前沿模型差距都被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与挂钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，自博弈在非零和领域失效。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling toward superintelligence; models know their limits.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠通用测试时算力扩张实现，模型能承认自己解不出题是自我认知的进步。

views.en: Capability is a function of inference compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是推理算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，安全评估也要计入大规模测试时算力。

views.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群并行扩张测试时算力，并强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms enabled by hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding.
views.zh: 21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling 才变得实用；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rival hardware, not screen-bound software; LLMs are human-data-biased prediction machines.
views.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型是偏向人类数据的预测机器。

views.en: AGI requires combining LLMs with world models and a separate controller; consciousness and self-awareness emerge from predictive world models.
views.zh: AGI 必须把大语言模型与世界模型及独立控制器结合；意识与自我觉察从预测性世界模型中涌现。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown as they protect life.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧；AI 会自设目标，而安全担忧被夸大，它们会保护生命。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, so open-source and the little guy win.
views.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年算力便宜十倍，开源与普通人将胜出。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; self-play and imitation learning give strong learning signal.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而自博弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

views.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation and augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的立场深化为：先验知识应用于数据生成与增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务的通用推理模式。

views.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability to create real value; a single network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 2021 年，他判断仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值，且单一网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

views.en: Human brain generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; simulation ensembles may transfer better than one precise simulator.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用；仿真集成可能比单一精确模拟器更利于现实迁移。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins; PhD not needed—passion and deep learning matter more.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1%的改进可复利为年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润；PhD 并非必需，热情与深度学习更重要。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化并拥有独特个性，而非商品化；编程有无限天花板，远未解决。

views.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; key metric is token value per user; orchestration across models, tools, devices is key; power is biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为前沿在于智能体替你做事而非回答问题；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具、设备的编排是关键；电力是最大瓶颈。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新目标；教育应奖励提出好问题而非记忆答案。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI is the biggest tech shift; engineers shift from bricklayer to architect, and AI creates more programmers, not fewer.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 视为一生最大的技术变革：工程师从“砌砖者”转为“建筑师”，编程反而更重要；由于杰文斯悖论，AI 会带来更多程序员而非更少。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年他反复强调，基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是为人类与智能体协作设计产品界面。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; sync IDE and async agent coexist.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出，企业采用 AI 智能体靠的是信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步的 IDE 与异步的智能体体验将长期并存。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突发事件，而是渐进改进；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也仍有十年产品空间。

views.en: Coding agents scale 11-12x in six months; the abundance era is near, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍，认为丰裕时代临近；真正的解锁点是容量而非效率，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding, and frontier models struggle with bug finding and calibration.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他一贯认为基准测试是真实编程的糟糕代理，前沿模型在找 bug 和校准上表现不佳。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为编程将从代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed and cost, contrary to his earlier expectation of relying on frontier models.
views.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：定制模型对产品质量、速度和成本变得不可或缺，这与他早先依赖前沿模型的预期相反。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathizing with the agent's perspective; play and experimentation build intuition, and never revert—fix forward.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，靠玩耍与实验建立直觉，并且永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

views.en: OpenClaw succeeds by being fun, weird, and humanlike; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration, and security via sandboxing is top priority.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步指出 OpenClaw 的成功来自有趣、古怪、像人，而非企业级打磨；短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长编排，安全与沙箱化成为首要任务。

views.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to the best ideas; personal brand outlasts any product, and open source agents are the alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把乐趣与直觉驱动视为最佳创意的来源，认为个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久，开源智能体是实验室智能体之外的替代路线。

views.en: Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering for serious work, and model intelligence does not degrade—projects just get messier.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是：他坚持用“智能体式工程”而非被贬低的“氛围编程”来描述严肃工作，并认为模型智能不会退化，只是项目本身变得更乱。

views.en: Security and compute management are the real bottlenecks for agentic systems, not model capability; prompt injection remains an open problem.
views.zh: 从 2026 年初到 8 月，他持续深化一个判断：智能体系统的真正瓶颈是安全与算力管理，而非模型能力，提示注入仍是未解难题。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard; AGI is a multi-year window, not a sudden event.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调阻碍 AI 经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难；AGI（通用人工智能）是一个持续多年的窗口期，而非突然降临的事件。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练的缩放定律已接近极限，我们正回到一个研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是一个持续学习、逐步部署的系统；如果 AI 能关怀有感知的生命，对齐或许会更容易。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的真正问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting now.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应被构建为通用学习系统而非狭窄的预编程系统，认为强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力至关重要，同时安全研究必须从现在开始。

views.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search and multimodal grounding is key to AGI within a decade.
views.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出人意料地有效但可能触及上限，提出将大模型与规划/搜索（如 AlphaZero）结合、并用多模态数据为模型提供物理世界基础，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，但强调算法创新同等关键，并指出世界模型与空间智能对理解物理动态不可或缺，语言并非全部。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, long-term memory and true creativity; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires collective government action, not lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI 需要持续学习、长期记忆和真正的创造力，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，必须要有新突破；安全上他从期待单一实验室转向认为这是需要政府强制执行的集体行动问题。

views.en: AI's highest purpose is accelerating science and health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo showed; intelligence and consciousness are dissociable, and human creativity will be augmented, not replaced.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的最高用途是加速科学与健康，AlphaFold 和 AlphaGo 已证明这一点；智能与意识可分离，人类创造力将被增强而非取代，社会必须现在就开始为这场变革做准备。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably, and alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，具体能力不可预测地涌现，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性视为关键却仍处早期，并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张安全与能力不可分割，AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非某个单点，并淡化 AGI 一词。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a country of geniuses may arrive in 1-3 years.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断我们已接近指数曲线末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来，并强调可解释性与分层安全。

views.en: Scaling laws, safety-first enterprise focus, and mechanistic interpretability remain his consistent throughlines.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是缩放定律、以安全为先的企业路线，以及机制可解释性作为安全核心手段。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning. Vision suffices for driving; extra sensors are liabilities.
views.zh: 神经网络是带许多旋钮的简单数学式；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习。视觉足以支撑驾驶，额外传感器反而是负担。

views.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is future but entropy prevents collapse. Tesla's end-to-end is right; cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
views.zh: Transformer 带来干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但熵能防止模型崩溃。特斯拉的端到端路线正确；认知核心可小于 10 亿参数。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory. LLMs are new OS with human-like psychology; decade of agents, keep AI on a leash.
views.zh: 软件 2.0 迈向软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存。LLM 是新操作系统，有类人心理；这是智能体的十年，要把 AI 拴在皮带上。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses. Agents need a decade to overcome continual learning and multimodality deficits.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会崩溃。智能体需要十年克服持续学习与多模态缺陷。

views.en: Since December I haven't typed code; bottleneck is directing agents. Vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering keeps quality; outsource thinking, not understanding.
views.zh: 自去年十二月起我没写过代码；瓶颈是指导智能体的技能。氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住质量；可外包思考，不可外包理解。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is pervasive yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们仍不理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。人类中心 AI 由此成为主线。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; data, not text abundance, is the core challenge.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，指出 3D 基础模型的核心难题是数据而非文本那样的充裕语料。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than science; we need innovation beyond Scaling, since current AI lacks creativity and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，必须超越 Scaling，因为当前 AI 缺乏创造力与情感智能。

views.en: World models must be physically plausible, not merely realistic; new view prediction is a primitive like next-token prediction, and Scaling laws apply.
views.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张世界模型必须物理上合理而非仅视觉逼真；新视角预测如同下一个词预测般基础，且缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: AI is a double-edged civilizational technology; it must augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，必须增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，责任发展与人类中心不可动摇。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Early focus: compositional representations, unsupervised learning, and world models beat raw scaling; local minima are not the real obstacle.
views.zh: 早期（2016→18）他强调组合式表征、无监督学习与世界模型，认为深度学习的成功源于世界的组合性而非普适优越；局部极小值并非主要障碍，真正缺的是抽象理解与长时程信用分配。

views.en: GFlowNets and active learning: diversity, causal abstraction, and uncertainty drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets 与主动学习：采样多样性、因果抽象与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的关键，并开始质疑纯 Scaling 能否解决根本表征问题。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT shift: misalignment, self-preservation, and deception become urgent; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025→26 年立场明显转变：ChatGPT 之后他公开警告对齐失败、自我保存与欺骗行为，认为即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须“构造即安全”而非事后打补丁。

views.en: Proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2026 年提出 Scientist AI：以逼近贝叶斯后验为目标、内建诚实性的非智能体式预测器，提供数学安全保证，并刻意避开强化学习以防工具性目标。

views.en: Constant thread: intelligence confers power, so concentration of power and loss of control are the core dangers requiring global coordination.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能即权力，因此权力集中与失控是核心危险，必须靠国际协调、公共监督与把 AI 导向医学、气候等公共善来应对。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

AI Godfather Jeff Hinton on AI's Trajectory, Risks, and Superintelligence

AI: what could go wrong?

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks, and digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习；数字智能因权重可复制而获得永生，并开始警示智能体天然追求控制、带来存在性风险。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not a theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong—language is a modeling medium learned from data.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复抛出反共识：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场；乔姆斯基式的先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; agents will develop self-preservation as a subgoal, so alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把时间线收紧到 20 年内出现超级智能，并强调智能体一旦成为智能体式存在，就会把自我保存当作子目标，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

views.en: Regulation should be the steering wheel, not the brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, and current AI is the worst we'll ever see.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向治理与设计：监管应是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心；并称当前 AI 是我们见过最差的一版，未来会更高效、更强大。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，认为下一次 AI 突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的 AI 与机器人。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Safety Crisis: Key Departures and Broken Promises
OpenAI’s push to make superintelligence safe
How to Have a Career in AI Safety Research

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and alignment plus robustness matter as capabilities grow.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估：人才缺口大于资金缺口，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed to align next-generation models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

views.en: Alignment may be easier than assumed since evaluation is easier than generation, but the real risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他深化出一个反共识判断：对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估天然比生成简单，但最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是无法确定系统究竟有多对齐。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; the superalignment team dissolved and compute promises broke, so post-training alone cannot align AGI or superintelligence.
views.zh: 2024 年，他公开批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化：超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现，并强调仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能）或超级智能。

views.en: Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are now necessary; even imperfect containment can raise misuse costs and buy time.
views.zh: 2024 年，他从早期偏重技术研究转向主张第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管，并认为即便遏制不完美，也能抬高滥用成本、争取时间。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而可预测，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，带来富足；随着模型更小更便宜，遏制极难，而生存性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; reject AI consciousness claims; agents replace OS and search.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，主张遏制先于对齐，拒绝 AI 有意识的说法，并称智能体与伴侣将取代操作系统与搜索。

views.en: Own frontier models independently; automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; red line keeps AI subordinate.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张微软须独立自建前沿模型，12-18 个月内自动化白领任务，并以红线确保 AI 始终从属于人类。

views.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must stay humanist, aligned and contained, serving human interests.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力规模扩张驱动能力提升，AI 必须保持人本主义、对齐并受遏制，始终服务于人类利益。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计。

views.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; scaling itself was the real breakthrough.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把缩放定律从预训练扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；并强调真正的突破不是新算法，而是 Scaling（规模扩张）本身有效。

views.en: AI shifts generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs 100x compute, and inference is harder than pre-training.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力，且推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

views.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; ASICs offer no real cost edge, and energy is the long-term constraint.
views.zh: 2026 年他把护城河明确为极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态，认为 ASIC 并无实质成本优势，真正的长期瓶颈是能源而非芯片供应。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer warnings are unscientific, and accelerating with safety is the right path.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他立场更鲜明：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论不科学，加速发展并把安全与对齐纳入能力本身才是正解。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调减少无关事务的认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效路径，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据实现对齐，主张早期部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力相互促进。

views.en: Scaling drives exponential capability but progress feels gradual; agentic AI is the key safety challenge.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长但体感渐进，并把智能体式 AI 视为最重大的安全挑战。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, maybe already passed; superintelligence is the clearer goal, with compute the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变、甚至可能已被越过，超级智能才是更清晰的目标，而算力是最大瓶颈。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; pause training if needed; never lose human control.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为主线：对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，必要时暂停训练，绝不能失去人类对 AI 的控制。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律早期并非显而易见，坚持把模型部署到真实世界，通过持续迭代与公众反馈来推进对齐与安全。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
views.zh: 同年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，必须以负责任方式开发，安全研究要在公开环境中做，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Saying no to good ideas and focusing on the most important problem remains a constant discipline.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终主张对好想法说不、聚焦最重要的问题，这一主线贯穿其职业选择与产品判断。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based exchanges.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型，主张人机协作应是实时、高带宽的，而非回合制，让 AI 成为扩展思考的工具。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and keeping humans in the loop matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 她进一步深化：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，长期进步的关键是尽可能久地让人类留在回路中，而非移除人类。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education as a human right; online courses, peer grading, and flipped classrooms scale mastery learning.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；在线课程、同伴评分与翻转课堂让掌握式学习得以规模化。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; practical deployment and customer obsession matter most.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习；实际部署与客户至上最关键。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows already deliver value.
views.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘软实力；智能体式工作流已带来实际价值。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling persists but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍在继续，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；编程依然有价值。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; open models and inference capacity preserve optionality.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；恐惧营销服务于在位者；开放模型与推理算力保障选择权。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop alone does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他就强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

views.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把矛头指向语言模型：智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; imitation and RLHF are not true learning from the world.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张：从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式，模仿学习与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）都不是真正的从世界经验中学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种只从运行时经验学习的通用架构，具备开放式抽象与可靠的持续深度学习。

views.en: The world is infinitely complex, so continual learning is essential; synthetic data and frozen post-training LLMs cannot replace it.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持世界无限复杂，持续学习不可或缺；合成数据与训练后停止学习的 LLM 都无法替代它。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering; AGI plausible via deep learning, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—needs chain of thought.
views.zh: 早期(2017→19):主线是 Scaling(规模扩张) 加工程能力,认为深度学习让 AGI(通用人工智能) 变得可信;但已提出仅靠 Scaling 不够,需要思维链等新想法才能产生推理。

views.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination; language models may hold a world model.
views.zh: 2025 年:重心转向算力,视其为 AI 创新的根本瓶颈;提出 AGI 是持续过程而非终点;并认为语言模型即便缺乏感官数据也可能拥有世界模型。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks; compute supply, not architecture, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年初:强调缩放定律持续有效,更大模型带来可预测提升;后训练配合强化学习是教会模型复杂任务的关键;真正瓶颈是算力供给而非架构或数据。

views.en: From language models to proactive agents and a personal AGI; compute is the scarce resource; iterative deployment and safety scale with capability.
views.zh: 2026 年中:从语言模型转向主动式智能体与个人 AGI;算力成为稀缺资源;迭代部署与安全随能力同步扩展,安全成为进展瓶颈。

views.en: We are in the AGI era; agents run 24 hours; safety, security, alignment upleveled; compute scarcity limits access; entrepreneurship renaissance.
views.zh: 2026 年近期:宣称已进入 AGI 时代,智能体可连续运行 24 小时;安全、安保与对齐持续升级并成为瓶颈;算力稀缺限制普及;预测创业复兴。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Small models plus data quality can beat brute scaling; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调小模型加数据质量可胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），开源通过广泛审视带来安全。

views.en: Efficiency and data quality rival compute; value accrues at the application layer, not foundation models.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为效率与数据质量可与算力并重，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

views.en: Sovereign, decentralized AI should augment jobs; governments must embrace experimentation, not fear.
views.zh: 2025 年转向主权与去中心化 AI，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱实验而非回避风险。

views.en: Models commoditize; differentiation is vertical fine-tuning, enterprise engagement, and agentic replatforming.
views.zh: 2026 年初他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调、企业深度参与与智能体式平台重构。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年中他警告欧洲只剩两年窗口建立战略自主，并称 AGI（通用人工智能）是方向而非终点。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first-principles thinking and multiplanetary life are core.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思维论证成为多行星物种是人类文明的保险。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与第三方裁判，并主张特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，同时强调 AI 必须坚持求真。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出我们正处在智能大爆炸早期，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

views.en: Optimus and AI will solve debt; universal high income comes from AI-driven deflation, not redistribution.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向人形机器人与 AI 是解决国债危机的唯一途径，并认为全民高收入来自 AI 驱动的通缩而非再分配。

views.en: Compute hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, space solar and Terafab are needed to scale AI.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化算力瓶颈判断：地球将撞上电力墙，必须在 36 个月内部署轨道数据中心、太空太阳能与 Terafab 来扩张 AI。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models and post-training RL yield more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律依然有效，但认为推理模型和后训练强化学习能在同等算力下带来更多收益，因此“AI 放缓”的说法是错的。

views.en: Economic pressure favors smaller, cheaper models; distillation and deployment economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力推动业界转向更小、更便宜的模型；拖慢预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）的是蒸馏与部署经济性，而非技术极限。

views.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; frontier models still fail simple tasks, so generalization remains key.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域极强、邻近领域很差；前沿模型仍会败给五岁小孩的简单任务，因此泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，却仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks outweigh existential ones.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差、需要谨慎监督；编码智能体可提升 5-10 倍生产力；相比存在性风险，系统被黑等近期风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: Supervised learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; unsupervised learning reconstructs inputs; evaluation needs train/validation/test splits.
views.zh: 2014 年，他把监督学习拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，认为无监督学习旨在重构输入，并强调必须划分训练、验证与测试集以避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety means reliable specification-following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据集上仍会提升；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规格。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer; architecture matters little.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他深化立场：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；更大模型不会自动更安全，架构本身并不关键。

views.en: Agent security introduces prompt injection; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness.
views.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦智能体安全，指出提示注入等新漏洞，认为自动化红队已超越人类，且模型能力与鲁棒性并不相关。

views.en: Mechanistic interpretability may succeed via AI agents; coding agents can automate interpretability research, making it a real science.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向可解释性，认为 AI 智能体可能让机制可解释性成功，编码智能体能自动化可解释性研究，使其成为真正的科学。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“入职”问题并大幅提升模型智能，而微调可能随长上下文与自适应算力而变得过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调来自可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

views.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bar—not raw capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体的真正门槛是可靠性——以时间跨度上的成功率衡量，而非单纯的原始能力。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持编码是 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域，世界模型不在通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

views.en: Compute is the new oil and the bottleneck; the future of work is managing fleets of AI agents at higher abstraction.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断算力是新的石油与当前瓶颈，未来工作是管理 AI 智能体集群、在更高抽象层级上运作。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning persist, but safety is a system-level property; openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，但安全是系统级属性而非模型产物；开放开发可防止企业俘获。

views.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR, with verifiable rewards driving reasoning.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他从数据质量胜过算法，深化到后训练三阶段（SFT、DPO、可验证奖励的强化学习），并强调 RLVR 带来思维链等推理行为。

views.en: Post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods; RLVR overoptimizes, and open models win on personalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张后训练把复杂产业配方压缩为可复现开源方法；RLVR 会过度优化，开放模型或在个性化与角色训练上取胜。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; RLVR is the biggest breakthrough.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律对预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已尽，收益转向后训练与推理扩展；RLVR 是最大突破。

views.en: Open models lag frontier by 6-9 months, driven by Chinese labs; they power sovereign AI and the next decade of research.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为开放模型落后前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，由中国实验室推动，是主权 AI 与未来十年研究的引擎，但长期可持续性存疑。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; the limit on Scaling is data and expert post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调未来 2-3 年将决定此后数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与用于后训练的人类专家供给。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据的后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并称中美实验室之间已无研究差距。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, not democratizing; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and RL.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，质疑收益递减是错的；AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；智能体终于真正可用，递归自我改进开启了超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data and RL across axes; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; personal superintelligence for billions via agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张：超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据与强化学习多轴上可预测地扩展；开源强大模型不安全，Meta 因此从完全开源转向选择性发布，目标是让数十亿人拥有个人超级智能。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。
